## Install

From a clone (requires Python \>= 3.9):

``` sh
git clone https://github.com/moneebullah25/muneebgrad.git
cd muneebgrad
pip install -e .
```

Or directly from GitHub:

``` sh
pip install git+https://github.com/moneebullah25/muneebgrad.git
```

The package is not published on PyPI.

## Development

Source of truth is the notebooks in `nbs/`; `muneebgrad/*.py` are
generated by nbdev. Requires `nbdev` (and Quarto for docs).

``` sh
nbdev_prepare   # export, test and clean notebooks
```

CI (`.github/workflows/test.yaml`) runs the fastai `nbdev-ci` workflow;
`deploy.yaml` publishes the Quarto docs to GitHub Pages.
